messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: SEV=P1 streaming-endpoint p99 spike detected for /v1/stream/generate · p99=2.8s (SLO=1.5s) · rolling dimm: calib-v3 (int8) rolled to 60% traffic at 13:04 UTC · alert: https://ops.redwood/alerts/ALERT-8241

oncall-maya: saw the page, jumping in. does the alert show increased queue depth or CPU/GPU stall?

ml-eng-jia: from perf dashboard: GPU utilization normal, but per-request stall aligned with kv-cache dequant timeouts. p95 ~ 600ms, p99 2.7-2.9s, tail spikes correlate with 2x longer dequant step on quantized kernels after calib-v3.

runtime-ken: logs show recurring: `KV_FETCH_WARN: dequant_timeout 1200ms` right before stall. also streaming goroutine counts spike briefly then recover.

oncall-maya: ok mark impact: customer-facing streaming degraded, some sessions saw chunked stalls (clients time out at 10s). paging support. @support-liz can you surface any customer reports?

support-liz: two customers opened support tickets in last 40m reporting intermittent audio transcript lag and truncated streams, both on dedicated capacity but routed through hosted inference fallback. escalating to account owners now.

prod-ana: are we seeing any error rates increase? or only latency?

ml-eng-jia: error rates stable. it's latency/tail only. my read: new calibration (calib-v3) changed scale factors for several layers causing slower dequant kernel on certain sequence-length buckets. Likely regression in int8 kernel path at high kv reuse.

infra-sam: traffic slice with calib-v3 currently 60%. can we immediate rollback for streaming-critical routes?

runtime-ken: we can quick-route streaming flag to fallback variant (int8->fp16) for routes tagged streaming:true. command:```
# quick route override
redwood route update --service stream-gen --match "streaming:true" --model redwood/llama-xyz-fp16 --weight 100
```

oncall-maya: do it. Also prepare rollout rollback of calib-v3 to calib-v2 for model-variant in hosted fleet. Jia, can you confirm rollback command?

ml-eng-jia: yes. to rollback calibration:```
# rollback calibration profile
redwood model calib rollback --model redwood/llama-xyz-int8 --to calib-v2 --dry-run=false
```

infra-sam: executing route override now (will push within ~20s).

incident-bot: Route update started by infra-sam at 13:20:11 UTC · job-id=rb-77321

runtime-ken: confirm route override applied. streaming routes now pin to fp16 variant for all traffic. watching metrics.

(1m)

ml-eng-jia: rolling rollback of calibration queued to control plane, ETA ~2m for global rollforward. note: rollback will temporarily increase cost but restores stable kernels.

(3m)

runtime-ken: p99 dropped to 1.4s on streaming endpoints after route override. p95 ~ 420ms. tail spikes largely gone.

oncall-maya: great. mark mitigation: route override -> success. next step rollback calib-v3 in model catalog and then progressive revalidation. Jia, coordinate postmortem checks and canary tests.

ml-eng-jia: will run targeted canaries for long KV sequences and continuous streaming load. tests to run: 1) seq=2048 KV reuse, 2) interleaved short+long messages, 3) high-concurrency streaming (2000 rps). I will also diff kernel timings.

support-liz: contacting impacted accounts with summary and temporary mitigation done. asking if they saw any data loss; so far all report delays but no missing text. will send an outbound note.

prod-ana: notify SLAs/CS teams and prepare customer-safe post explaining we reverted a calibration profile that caused tail latency regressions for streaming workloads. include timeline and mitigation steps.

infra-sam: rollback command completed at 13:26:02 UTC · job-id=rbcalib-4491 · status=success

incident-bot: Post-mitigation metrics snapshot: streaming p99=1.35s, p95=410ms, error-rate unchanged. Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.

oncall-maya: assigning follow-ups: Jia (ml-eng) run regression analysis and produce repro script + perf diffs. Ken (runtime) add guardrail to control plane to prevent calib profile rollouts above 30% without kv-long canary. Sam (infra) add automatic rollback hook if p99>1.5s for 5m post-rollout. Liz (support) send customer update. Ana (product) prepare comms. I'll own the postmortem doc.

ml-eng-jia: noted. initial hypothesis: calib-v3 introduced per-channel scaling adjustments that caused one dequant kernel to switch to slow fallback path for certain tensor shapes. I'll capture kernel name and perf numbers.

runtime-ken: immediate follow-up: adding a streaming-only metric alert for dequant_timeout occurrences and KV_FETCH_WARN counts. will add alert rule and a dashboard tile.

support-liz: customers updated. two account owners requested RCA and ETA for safe return to int8. I'll collect requirements and pass to Jia.

prod-ana: also add cost delta estimate for rolling back to fp16: ~+30% token cost for affected routes while int8 is disabled. include in comms.

oncall-maya: closing active page. status: mitigated, on-call handoff scheduled: oncall-maya -> oncall-next at 21:00 UTC. please append notes to the incident doc.

incident-bot: Page closed by oncall-maya at 13:36:12 UTC · duration=12m1s · follow-ups assigned.

ml-eng-jia: I'll push a deterministic test to the evaluation harness and link it in the postmortem. preliminary kernel candidate: `dequant_kernel_int8_vfallback_v3` shows 2.8x slower median in some shape buckets.

infra-sam: adding autosafety: deploy gate will now require kv_longstream_canary:true annotation for calib profiles >30% rollout.

noncall-maya: thanks team. good triage and coordination.

support-liz: adding conversation thread IDs for the two customer tickets to the incident doc.

prod-ana: filing a follow-up to review calibration rollout runbook and add an explicit streaming canary checklist.

ml-eng-jia: taking action item: reproduce, patch calibration tool to avoid scaling that triggers fallback, and propose safe canary thresholds. ETA for patch: 48 hours.

noncall-maya: thanks. leaving this thread open for the postmortem link and any final data.

incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem template created: https://ops.redwood/incidents/pm/2624000000 (assigned to oncall-maya).
